contentChunks.footer:
Use the time picker that best complements the available space and existing interaction patterns:

  1. Scroll time picker

  2. Input time picker

  3. Dial input picker
contentChunks.altText: Full-scale presentation of three time picker variants: scroll, input, and dial.

contentChunks.htmlValue: Usage

Time pickers are used to enter a specific time value, usually hours and minutes. They can be placed inline with other content, on surfaces like bottom sheets, side sheets, menus, or in modal dialogs. Whenever possible, place time pickers inline so surrounding content remains visible.

Time pickers can be used for a wide range of use cases, like:

  • Setting an alarm

  • Scheduling a meeting

  • Choosing a time range

There are three time pickers: scroll, input, and dial.

contentChunks.footer: A scroll time picker can be used inline to set an alert
contentChunks.altText: Scroll time picker setting an alert with an option for recurring alert and additional fields for day of week and AM or PM.

contentChunks.htmlValue:
Scroll time picker

The scroll time picker is a compact way to select time. It’s best placed inline with other content, but can also be used on surfaces like a sheet, menu, or modal dialog.

Use scroll time pickers instead of dial pickers when you want people to see surrounding content.

Scroll time pickers can toggle to input time pickers.

contentChunks.footer: A scroll time picker for a 12-hour clock, with AM/PM selector visible
contentChunks.altText: Scroll time picker for a 12-hour clock, with AM/PM selector visible.

contentChunks.htmlValue:
Input time picker

The input time picker uses keyboard entry to input time. Similar to scroll time picker, it can be used inline or modal, on any kind of surface.

Both the dial and scroll time pickers are built to toggle to input time pickers to ensure accessible time entry.

contentChunks.footer: Input selector for a 12-hour clock, with AM/PM selector
contentChunks.altText: Input time picker for a 12-hour clock with the hour field active and highlighted and AM/PM selector visible.

contentChunks.htmlValue:
Dial time picker

Dial time pickers are the most engaging way to select time, but they take up the most space, and are only available in modal dialogs, not inline.

Avoid using dial time pickers for granular time selection, such as milliseconds for a stopwatch application.

Dial time pickers can toggle to input time pickers.

contentChunks.footer: When using a 12-hour clock for dial select, numbers only appear in the outer ring
contentChunks.altText: Dial time picker for a 12-hour clock with hour 7 selected.

contentChunks.htmlValue:
Toggling to input selector

The input selector can be toggled from either the dial or scroll selector using the keyboard icon button.

Toggle back to dial picker with a clock icon. Toggle back to scroll picker with a swipe icon.

contentChunks.footer: Selecting the keyboard icon switches to direct input. Selecting the dial icon switches back to dial input.
contentChunks.altText: Dial time picker with keyboard icon button for toggling to input.

contentChunks.htmlValue: 24-hour time selection

The time picker should auto-adjust to 24-hour time settings, removing the AM and PM buttons, and adding the inner dial. For dial picker, time moves from 0-11 on the outer dial, switches to 12-23 on the inner dial, and returns to 00 on the outer dial for the 24th hour.

contentChunks.footer: 24-hour scroll and input time pickers have no AM and PM buttons
contentChunks.altText: Time picker with scroll input, with the hour field set to 18 and the minute field set to 30.

contentChunks.footer: 24-hour dial time picker has no AM and PM buttons, and has an inner dial
contentChunks.altText: Time picker with dial input selecting hour 20. Hours 0–11 use an outer dial, while hours 13–24 use an inner dial.

contentChunks.htmlValue: Alternate time selection components

Only use time pickers when any time can be chosen, down to the minute. If people only need to choose from preset times or intervals, consider using a simpler, smaller component like a button group, menu, or combo box.

contentChunks.footer: Use button groups when certain time options are unavailable
contentChunks.altText: Button groups listing multiple reservation times, with some missing.

contentChunks.footer: Use menus or combo boxes when time options are limited and part of a range
contentChunks.altText: A calendar app showing multiple times for a meeting, in 15-minute increments.

contentChunks.htmlValue: Customization

Text & containers

Typography can be customized for more expressive time selection experiences, such as stretching, narrowing, and rounding the text.

When using narrower and larger typography, use taller scroll field heights so the surrounding options are at least half-visible.

contentChunks.footer: Adjust scroll field container height when increasing size of typography
contentChunks.altText: Scroll time picker with large, bold, and narrow numerals.

contentChunks.htmlValue:
Color

When customizing color, make sure both active and inactive values maintain the required contrast ratio with the scroll field background.

contentChunks.footer: When customizing color, maintain proper contrast between the numerals and scroll field
contentChunks.altText: Scroll time picker with custom colors applied.

contentChunks.htmlValue:
Container (modal)

When in a modal dialog, the time picker container should always be visible, appearing above other screen elements in front of a scrim.

The container usually isn’t needed when inline with other content.

contentChunks.footer:
1. Input time picker modal (with a container)

  2. Input time picker inline (without a container)
contentChunks.altText: 2 input time pickers, with and without containers.

contentChunks.htmlValue:
Input toggle button

An icon button must be present to toggle from a dial or scroll time picker to an input time picker.

If not using the built-in toggle, make sure a toggle is placed nearby.

contentChunks.footer: Don’t remove the built-in toggle button from dial or scroll time pickers without providing another way to toggle
contentChunks.altText: Cropped portion of dial selector without keyboard icon, removing path to input selector.

contentChunks.htmlValue: Placement

Inline

Whenever possible, place time pickers inline with content, rather than as a modal dialog. This makes it much easier for people to reference other content on the page when making their decision.

contentChunks.footer: Inline time pickers can be shown and hidden to preserve space when not in use
contentChunks.altText: A UI displaying a scroll time picker for the specific time of an event, surrounded by fields for date and setting time zone.

contentChunks.htmlValue:
Menus

On touch devices, when time pickers can't be placed inline, consider using a scroll time picker in a menu.

contentChunks.footer: If inline layout is not possible, use a menu to fully display the time picker
contentChunks.altText: Scroll time picker displayed in a menu.

contentChunks.htmlValue:
Modals

Time pickers can be in modal dialogs above a scrim. However, modals should be used rarely, when the UI is too cluttered for more components.

Dial time pickers are only available in modals.

contentChunks.footer: Modals block all other actions when active, though can save space in a busy UI
contentChunks.altText: A modal showing input time picker above a UI filled with fields for event details.

contentChunks.htmlValue: Adaptive design
Scroll and input time pickers can resize to fit the container they’re placed in. Each field should resize evenly.

contentChunks.footer: Scroll fields should expand in larger panes to allow for larger tap targets
contentChunks.altText: A calendar app using inline scroll time picker that expands when moving from compact to larger breakpoints.

contentChunks.htmlValue:
Dial time pickers should swap orientation or variant depending on the breakpoint and available vertical space. Avoid adding scrolling to dial time pickers.

For example:

  • At larger breakpoints with more space, swap from the vertical to horizontal dial time picker

  • When vertical space is reduced, like rotating a phone, swap to the landscape dial picker to avoid scrolling or cutting off the dial

  • When vertical space is very limited, or the interface is zoomed in, swap from dial to a scroll or input time picker

contentChunks.footer: Don’t cut off the dial time picker. Instead, swap to horizontal orientation, or to another time picker.
contentChunks.altText: A dial time picker in vertical configuration, which is too tall for mobile in landscape mode.

contentChunks.htmlValue: Behavior

Scroll time pickers

Swipe the scroll fields to select a time value. Values snap into place when released.

Tap the inactive value above or below to navigate to it.

The keyboard icon swaps the component to an input time picker.

contentChunks.footer: The scroll time picker supports both scrolling and direct input
contentChunks.altText: Scroll time picker with options to swipe and tap, or select the keyboard icon for direct input.

contentChunks.htmlValue:
Dial time pickers

When the dial time picker is opened, the hour field is selected by default. Once hour is selected by dial, the minutes field will activate to then select minutes by dial.

Selecting either field will reactivate the corresponding dial to select another option.

The keyboard icon swaps the component to an input time picker.

contentChunks.footer: The dial time picker supports both direct and dial input
contentChunks.altText: Dial time picker with hour field selected, and keyboard icon to access direct input.

contentChunks.htmlValue:
Input time picker

Select a text field to activate the keyboard entry and input a time value.

Errors should appear below the time picker, and highlight the invalid field with an error color scheme.

contentChunks.footer: The swipe icon allows the input selector to switch to scroll selector
contentChunks.altText: Input time picker with swiping icon to access scroll selector.

contentChunks.htmlValue:
Modals & motion

When appearing in a modal, time pickers use appearing and disappearing transitions similar to dialogs.

The OK button confirms the selection and closes the modal. The Cancel button, and interacting on the scrim, dismisses the changes and closes the modal.

contentChunks.footer: OK or Cancel closes the modal
contentChunks.altText: Time picker enter and exit transitions based on dialogs.

contentChunks.htmlValue: Use cases

People should be able to use assistive technology to:

  • Select or enter hours, minutes, seconds, or milliseconds

  • Choose between 12-hour or 24-hour clock format

  • Enter time selection directly using input fields
Interaction & style

Material requires time pickers to allow direct time entry through text input in addition to the scroll and dial selector. This toggle is built into the component by default.

Allowing text input makes it easier for those using keyboard inputs rather than touch screens.

contentChunks.footer: Text input is available for both dial and scroll time pickers
contentChunks.altText: Time picker with active manual text input for hours.

contentChunks.htmlValue:
Targets

Targets for a scroll field’s inactive values need to be at least 48dp high.

The tap targets for the AM/PM button and input toggle need to be at least 48x48dp.

contentChunks.footer: Scroll fields, whether active or inactive, must be at least 48dp high
contentChunks.altText: Diagram showing scroll fields' target sizes.

contentChunks.htmlValue: Targets for each dial item need to be at least 48x48dp.

contentChunks.footer: Dial targets should be a minimum of 48x48dp
contentChunks.altText: Dial time picker selector specs, selecting hour 7.

contentChunks.htmlValue: Keyboard navigation

Keys

Actions

Tab

Focus lands on (non-disabled) time slot, and moves to the next element

Shift + Tab

Focus moves to the previous element

Arrow keys

Focus moves between hours or minutes, once hour or minute field is selected.

When AM/PM radio group is focused, selection moves between AM and PM.

Up / down moves to previous / next option in scroll field.

Space or Enter

Activates the (non-disabled) time slot or button.

Allows direct entry of numbers in input.

Confirms hour and minute for dial, input, and scroll.
Labeling elements
The hour and minute fields have different roles depending on the type of time picker.

contentChunks.footer: On dial time pickers, the fields are toggles, not directly editable text fields
contentChunks.altText: Accessibility tag on a dial time picker's hour field lists “Toggle” for the element.

contentChunks.footer: On input time pickers, the fields are text inputs
contentChunks.altText: Accessibility tag on an input time picker's hour field lists “Text input” for role.

contentChunks.footer: On scroll time pickers, the fields are rotors
contentChunks.altText: Accessibility tag on a scroll time picker's hour  field lists “Rotor” for element.

contentChunks.htmlValue: The AM/PM buttons use a radio group role, as only one can be selected at a time.

contentChunks.footer: The AM/PM buttons are radio group. Selecting one unselects the other.
contentChunks.altText: Accessibility tag on the AM button lists “Label: AM, Role: Button.”

contentChunks.htmlValue:
Each hour on the dial input is listed out of 12 for a 12-hour dial. Minutes are listed out of 60. Examples:

  • “Hour 7 of 12”

  • “Hour 23”

  • “Minute 24 of 60”

contentChunks.footer: The label on a dial time picker shows the hour out of 12, on a 12-hour dial
contentChunks.altText: Accessibility tag on the time picker's dial selector lists "Hour 7 of 12.”

contentChunks.htmlValue:
Dial navigation

Tab to move through the hour, minute, and AM/PM options. Use arrow keys to toggle between AM and PM, and Enter to select.

Enter on the hour or minute field will allow selection of specific numbers. Once focus moves to the dial, it begins on minute 0 or hour 12. Right or Down will move through hours or minutes clockwise. Left or Up will move counter-clockwise.

Selecting Enter will confirm hour or minute.

contentChunks.footer: Right or Down moves the dial clockwise. Left or Up moves the dial counter-clockwise.
contentChunks.altText: A dial time picker with Tab and Left key moving the dial selector clockwise.
